output.review_comment:
The implementation correctly passes all tests using banker's rounding (round-half-to-even), but this directly contradicts the docstring which states "a time exactly halfway between two boundaries rounds up to the later one." For example, 09:15 with 30-minute slots rounds to 09:00 (earlier boundary), not 09:30 (later boundary). 

While the tests are correct (as specified by the teammate), the docstring must be updated to accurately reflect the banker's rounding behavior. This is necessary to avoid misleading future developers about the actual API contract. Please update the docstring to document the round-half-to-even behavior.
